explanation: The theorem is about TauCeti's own definition `Valuation.ord v f = -WithZero.log (v f)`, which has no counterpart in Mathlib (grep over Mathlib for `ord` in `Mathlib/RingTheory/Valuation/**` returns nothing; the only `ord`s are unrelated — `X.ord` for order of vanishing on schemes in `Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/OrderOfVanishing.lean`, `Ring.ord`/`Ring.ordFrac` with values in ℕ∞/ℤᵐ⁰ in `Mathlib/RingTheory/OrderOfVanishing/*`, `Ordinal.ord`, etc.). No Mathlib declaration states `ord (f ^ n) = n * ord f` for this order. The only Mathlib ingredients are the generic `WithZero.log_zpow` (`Mathlib/Algebra/GroupWithZero/WithZero.lean:468`) and `MonoidWithZeroHom.map_zpow₀`, which the library's proof indeed combines (together with `mul_neg`), so the result is not the statement of a single Mathlib declaration, nor a one-line specialization of one. I also checked `MonoidWithZeroHom`/`map_zpow₀`, `Ring.ord_pow`, `IsRankOneDiscrete` lemmas and `Ring.ordFrac_*` for a matching zpow/order identity; none matches.
